content.text: What Each Option Actually Offers

The Sovereign Starter Stack ($97) provides a comprehensive solution for digital creators, featuring GitHub Pages for hosting, Cloudflare Workers for backend logic, Supabase for order storage, and NOWPayments for automatic crypto payment verification. This stack is ideal for creators who want to deploy a fully operational online store in just 48 hours, with support for up to 3 products and 30-day support. On the other hand, the Edge Commerce Stack ($197) offers a more advanced solution, featuring Cloudflare Pages for hosting, Cloudflare Workers for backend logic, Supabase for order storage, and NOWPayments for automatic crypto payment verification. This stack is designed for creators who require more advanced features, including SPF/DKIM/DMARC configuration and end-to-end testing, with support for up to 5 products and 30-day support.
How They Handle Restricted Countries

COREMERCH acknowledges the severe restrictions faced by digital creators in certain countries when it comes to payment processing. Unlike other platforms that rely on restrictive payment gateways, COREMERCH offers a sovereign commerce infrastructure solution that allows creators to accept cryptocurrency payments directly, without the need for intermediaries. This not only resolves the issue of restricted countries but also enables creators to maintain full control over their payment processing, without relying on third-party services. With COREMERCH, creators can focus on building their business, rather than navigating complex payment systems.
Payment Speed, Fees, and Real Costs

When it comes to payment speed, fees, and real costs, COREMERCH offers a more transparent and cost-effective solution compared to traditional payment platforms.
